title: Signal: Laravel Whoops error page disclosed

check.valuePattern: Whoops, looks like something went wrong

scope: One response body containing the Whoops error heading.
limitations: Body marker check on one response. A custom page that reproduces the marker can be reported; the rule cannot prove that the stack is readable.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Whoops, looks like something went wrong.</title></head><body>ErrorException in HomeController.php line 42</body></html>
Something went wrong. Please try again later.

fpNotes: A page that reproduces the phrase as text can be reported; the rule cannot tell a rendered handler from quoted content.
